annotation.title_clean: Intelligent Robots Development and Distribution Promotion Act
annotation.title_en: Intelligent Robots Development and Distribution Promotion Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Assembly of the Republic of Korea (Korea Legislation Research Institute translation)
annotation.summary_en: English translation of South Korea's Intelligent Robots Development and Distribution Promotion Act (as amended Oct 2025). It sets five-year basic plans, a robot industry policy council, an ethics charter, robotland zones, and a safety certification and mandatory liability insurance regime for outdoor mobile (delivery) robots, with penalties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five-year basic plans and a policy council within the trade ministry, including a robot ethics advisory committee and ethics charter
Operational safety certification for outdoor mobile robots on sidewalks, with designated certification institutions and revocation powers
Mandatory liability insurance or mutual aid for operators of certified outdoor mobile robots
Robotland designation and support, and the Korea Institute for Robot Industry Advancement
Penalties of up to three years' imprisonment or 30 million won for certification fraud or unauthorized marks
